title: Glowing rain cloud
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b0e0ff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4a90d9' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cloudGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8e6ff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#8ec5ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6aabee'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='dropGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a0d8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4a90d9'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='44' ry='30' fill='url(#glow)' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- cloud body -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='32' cy='40' rx='18' ry='14' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='34' rx='20' ry='16' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='40' rx='16' ry='13' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='30' ry='12' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
    <!-- cloud highlights -->
    <ellipse cx='46' cy='30' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#d8efff' opacity='0.7'/>
    <ellipse cx='28' cy='36' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#d8efff' opacity='0.6'/>
    <ellipse cx='68' cy='36' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#d8efff' opacity='0.6'/>
    <!-- cloud lower shade -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='28' ry='6' fill='#5a9ad8' opacity='0.6'/>
  </g>

  <!-- rain drops -->
  <g>
    <path d='M30 56 Q30 50 33 48 Q36 50 36 56 Q36 62 33 64 Q30 62 30 56 Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
    <path d='M46 58 Q46 52 49 50 Q52 52 52 58 Q52 64 49 66 Q46 64 46 58 Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
    <path d='M62 56 Q62 50 65 48 Q68 50 68 56 Q68 62 65 64 Q62 62 62 56 Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
    <path d='M38 70 Q38 65 41 63 Q44 65 44 70 Q44 75 41 77 Q38 75 38 70 Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
    <path d='M54 72 Q54 67 57 65 Q60 67 60 72 Q60 77 57 79 Q54 77 54 72 Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
    <path d='M70 68 Q70 63 73 61 Q76 63 76 68 Q76 73 73 75 Q70 73 70 68 Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
  </g>

  <!-- drop highlights -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='32' cy='54' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#e0f4ff' opacity='0.8'/>
    <ellipse cx='48' cy='56' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#e0f4ff' opacity='0.8'/>
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='54' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#e0f4ff' opacity='0.8'/>
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='68' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#e0f4ff' opacity='0.8'/>
    <ellipse cx='56' cy='70' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#e0f4ff' opacity='0.8'/>
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='66' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#e0f4ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
